text: N248896January 14, 2014CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:356CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6110.30.3053Ms. Rosanna FlorentinoAugusta Sportswear425 Park West DriveGrovetown, GA  30813         RE:	The tariff classification of men’s and boys’ knit pullovers from Mexico.    Dear Ms. Florentino:In your letter dated December 17, 2013, you requested a tariff classification ruling on behalf of High Five.  As requested, your sample will be returned.The submitted sample, Style 100350 “Spector GK Jersey,” is a men’s cut and sewn pullover constructed from 100% polyester, finely knit fabric that measures 30 stitches per two centimeters counted in the horizontal direction.  Style 100350 has a contrasting color V-neckline; a self-fabric triangular insert at the front neckline; long, hemmed sleeves; contrasting color inserts on the shoulders and the sleeves; and a straight, hemmed bottom.  Style 100350 will be imported in Adult (men’s) sizes AS - AXL. You state that the same garment will be imported as Style 100351 in Youth (boys’) sizes YS - YL.The applicable subheading for Styles 100350 and 100351 will be 6110.30.3053,  Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of man-made fibers: other: other: other: other: men’s or boys’: other. The rate of duty is 32% ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Rosemarie Hayward at (646) 733-3064.Sincerely,Gwenn Klein KirschnerActing DirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of men’s and boys’ knit pullovers from Mexico.
